steps.action: Open the authenticated Email Delivery page
steps.expected: Delivery Log tab loads for the selected restaurant context
steps.observed: Opened /email-delivery with URL http://app.localhost:3000/email-delivery?restaurantId=a050d1ad-1ee0-4ea0-abc2-22c3778aa52c and page text included the restaurant context 'Old Crown'.

steps.action: Switch from Delivery Log to Queue
steps.expected: Queue content appears client-side while preserving restaurant context and avoiding a full page reload
steps.observed: Queue tab rendered queue controls/content such as 'Scheduled', 'Ready now', 'Sending now', and 'Needs attention'. URL changed to ?tab=queue, request log showed GET /api/ops/email-queue?restaurantId=a050d1ad-1ee0-4ea0-abc2-22c3778aa52c&page=1&pageSize=25, and the browser PerformanceNavigationTiming remained a single initial 'navigate' entry, indicating no full page reload. Restaurant context remained visible as 'Old Crown'.

steps.expected: Analytics content appears client-side while preserving restaurant context and avoiding a full page reload
steps.observed: Analytics tab rendered metrics content including 'Total attempts 1', 'Delivered 0 0% delivered', and 'More metrics'. URL became http://app.localhost:3000/email-delivery?tab=analytics, PerformanceNavigationTiming still showed only the original navigation entry, and restaurant context 'Old Crown' remained present.

evidence.clientSideTransition: Observed URL param updates (?tab=queue, ?tab=analytics) with only one PerformanceNavigationTiming entry of type 'navigate' for the initial page load; no route-level full page reload observed during tab switches.

frictions.description: Password login redirected to /dashboard instead of /email-delivery after sign-in, so the test needed a direct navigation back to the assigned page before tab validation.
frictions.resolution: Navigated directly to http://app.localhost:3000/email-delivery after successful authentication and continued validation in the same browser session.

summary: VAL-CROSS-001 passed. Delivery Log, Queue, and Analytics each rendered tab-specific content, preserved the Old Crown restaurant context, and switched client-side without evidence of a full page reload.
